newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-,6-mo same, 9-,12-mo up.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-,6-mo same, 9-,12-mo up.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month and six-month treasury bills were unchanged, and nine-month amdd 12-month T-bills yields rose from most recent sales, a central bank statement said on Friday.

Three-month bills remained at 24.24 percent, six-month bills remained at 30.34 percent, nine-month bills firmed to 32.99 percent from 32.93 percent, and 12-month bills rose to 38.02 percent from 37.54 percent.
The results of Friday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 1.14 million UAH 1.22 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.07 million UAH 1.15 million UAH
The central bank sold 11,391 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 31.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 1.39 million UAH 2.59 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.20 million UAH 2.25 million UAH
The central bank sold 13,868 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 31.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 1.76 million UAH 2.91 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.41 million UAH 2.34 million UAH
The central bank sold 17,630 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 31.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 7.22 million UAH 17.67 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.23 million UAH 12.85 million UAH
The central bank sold 72,184 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 31.
